changelog:
Initial release of Douyin Research Kit:

- Extract Douyin video metadata, subtitles, user profiles, music info, hashtags, and live stream stats using yt-dlp.
- Supports both full and short (v.douyin.com) URLs; auto-resolves short links.
- Provides guidance for handling cookies and region restrictions.
- Output structured data for research, including number formatting and Markdown-ready tables.
- Covers error handling, typical workflows, and tips for Douyin-specific research scenarios.
